purpose: Re-derivation of EXPECTED_GROUP_B_LANGS (analysis/build_release_calibration.py:75) on the special-token-corrected GlotLID-C model.

rule.source: analysis/diagnostic.py:168 (is_magnet), :177 head bar; selection at analysis/gate_variants.py:491-492
rule.expression: flat_magnet := (zH > ZH_MAGNET and magnet_ratio > MAGNET_RATIO_MIN) or (zH > ZH_EXTREME); group_b := flat_magnet and N >= HEAD_N

inputs.magnet_ratio: prediction-derived, val half of the seed-42 500k sample (diagnostic.py:79-90,140-149)

verification_against_committed_csv.note: all deviations are bounded by the CSV's own rounding (4dp / 3dp); no numerical disagreement

weight_derived_finding.measured: H_released = ln(5) + H_corrected/5 to 2.41e-06 nats; symKL_corrected = 5 * symKL_released to 1.07e-04
weight_derived_finding.cause: the released matrix stores each special token at log-prob 0.0, so diagnostic.py's unmasked softmax (diagnostic.py:47-57) puts 4/5 of every row's mass on the 4 specials; peak == 0.2000 for all 1,940 rows
weight_derived_finding.consequence: zH is a median/MAD robust z-score, invariant under a positive affine map, so zH is unchanged: max |zH_corrected - zH_released| = 0.003258 (lad_Hebr, zH ~ 120); 0 languages of 1,940 have |delta| > 0.01

prediction_derived_recompute.sample: seed-42 uniform draw of 500,000 of 45,627,279 test lines; indices regenerated as random.seed(42); sorted(random.sample(range(45627279), 500000)) (analysis/full_test_eval.py:49-53)
prediction_derived_recompute.alignment_gate: all 250,000 val-half labels re-read from glotlid_correct_test.txt match sample_500k_all.pkl['y_true'][::2] exactly; all 250,000 test-half labels match the full-pool y_true.npy
prediction_derived_recompute.val_half: positions with (index % 2) == 0 (diagnostic.py:71-76); outputs/diagnostic/val_mask.npy confirmed equal to that parity
prediction_derived_recompute.full_pool_arrays_unusable: full_test_eval.py:233-235 skips every val line, so pred_baseline.npy / pred_floor21.npy hold UNSEEN(-3) and y_true.npy holds EXCLUDED(-2) at all 250,000 val indices, in both the released and the corrected store
prediction_derived_recompute.how_recomputed_here: re-scored the 250,000 val lines directly with unilid.model_io.UnilidModel(..., calibrated=False) and best_of_cached_weight_sets_biased_batch(pre, [0.0]*1940), the zero-bias baseline config of full_test_eval.py:261-262 (~23 s per model)
prediction_derived_recompute.caveat: the recorded glotlidc_y_pred.txt is not bit-reproduced by the current scorer (0.9952, above full_test_eval.py's own 0.99 gate); the released_rescored column is the like-for-like control that isolates the matrix change

nearest_miss_on_the_zH_gate.note: under the released model szl_Latn cleared MAGNET_RATIO_MIN (2.075) and was excluded only by zH = 1.463 < 1.5; under the corrected model its magnet_ratio falls to 1.85, so it now fails both gates. zH is invariant, so it cannot enter via the weight side.
